# RankPatch

> C++17 and CPython library for exact, revision-aware top-k fusion across independently changing ranked lists. It can accept asynchronous retrieval workers' full snapshots and retractions in one coordinator.

- [Documentation and installation](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch#readme)
- [Binary wheels and supported platforms](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/release/wheels-0.1.0.md)
- [Measure your own revision stream locally](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/tree/main/bench/your_trace)
- [Measured comparison with released rankops](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/tree/main/bench/rankops)
- [Header](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/include/rankpatch.hpp)
- [Interactive JavaScript reference demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pgg-engineering/rankpatch)
- [LangChain retriever results for RAG, including runnable example](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/integrations/hybrid/README.md#langchain-retrievers)
- [SQLite FTS5, scikit-learn neighbors and string ID mapping](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/tree/main/integrations/hybrid)
- [Seven-event JSONL example accepted by the stdin runner](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/bench/your_trace/example.jsonl)
- [Async workers and JSON Lines input](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/examples/live_search.py)
- [Performance by fan-in, overlap and edit pattern](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/bench/README.md)
- [Real retrieval rankings with modeled updates, including a faster heap on growing pages](https://github.com/pgg898200-ship-it/rankpatch/blob/main/replay/README.md)

Use when multiple sources can revise or withdraw a list and clients need intermediate rankings. Positive integer positional scoring, dense IDs, one owner, no service or model. Benchmark times cover in-process updates and reads. For small fan-in and one-shot merges, a full rebuild can be faster.
